scope: LOG-BUDGET-01 version3 size-aware read local complete log_view rejection path only, 300000-byte dense match input, three encodings; no Agent/model/token claim

implementation.procedure: Read exact baseline/candidate and call path; verify lower bound across three formats
implementation.acceptance: Earlier identical rejection plus size-aware bounded read with sentinel/fallback; unchanged path/link/regular-file/max-byte security and output contracts

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare frozen baseline and candidate on valid controls and errors; ordinary/-O regression
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact JSON equality or matching exception class/message; new early rejection witness fails baseline; old observer fails read-request witness; growth within/exceed cap and empty/exact-bound cases pass; nonseekable adapter retains one full bounded read

data_integrity.procedure: Check all source/input/wrapper hashes and five alternating pairs per encoding
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/duplicate samples; raw exceptions exact; separate warmup/traced observations

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians/ratios and traced peak units
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite nonnegative times; peak is Python tracemalloc bytes not RSS

measurement_validity.procedure: Review full log_view timing scope, interleaved child runs, resource limits and repeat variation
measurement_validity.acceptance: Each encoding median wall>=10% improvement and all pairs>=5%; separate traced peak>=20% improvement; otherwise no benefit claim

reproducibility.procedure: Independently rerun focused tests and one full pair per format plus inspect wrapper
reproducibility.acceptance: Agree semantics; independent diagnostic rerun supports bounded failure-path result
